lines.t: Longing
Longing, longing
To return to the place where I came from
As a child I saw
Glimpses of the place where I came from
Fields of gentle beauty, where safety was found
A gentle, quiet place, calling me home
Looking at the stars, I could feel your love
Something in my heart knew where I was from
Holy hand from heaven, resting on my shoulder
Holy hand from heaven, drawing me in closer
I hear you calling, I've heard it all along
Your voice speaking to my heart, calling me home
Your holy presence, like a gentle rain on me
Awakening my soul to what is yet unseen
As I came of age, I began to lose my sight
Caught up in the shadows, chasing after night
Everything I chased, never satisfied
fight left me bruised within with nothing left inside a place within my heart only you could
feel i couldn't take the weight so i fell down and cried calling out your name to restore my side
holy hand from heaven resting on my shoulder holy hand from heaven
Seven, join me in closer.
I hear you call.
I've heard it all along.
Your voice speaking to my heart, calling me home.
Your holy presence, like a gentle rain on me,
Awakening my soul to what is yet unseen
Years have come and gone since that night of grace
I've been walking on, held within your ways
But I feel it now, drawing me again
Opening my eyes beyond where I have been
Clothed in your presence
Seeing what the flesh can't see
Stirring up a longing
For the place prepared for me
Hope is stirring in my heart
I can hear you calling me
Beyond this life I see
Come up here, come up here
